name: @pipeworx/mcp-cmf-chile

tools.name: cmf_sanctions
tools.description: Search the CMF (Chile's financial regulator) register of sanction resolutions, about 1,500 resolutions from 2002 to today: each row has the resolution number, date, subject (e.g. 'APLICA SANCIÓN A ITAÚ CORREDORES DE BOLSA LIMITADA') and a link to the resolution document. Filter by free-text query (Spanish; matches the subject, accent- and case-insensitive, all words must match) and/or year. Resolutions that name individuals are served with the person's name as the register publishes it (Bruce's case ruling of 2026-10-25, scoped to this tool): every row carries its source record (resolution number, date, CMF document link); no address is ever served for an individual and a natural person's RUT is stripped from the subject; anyone named can ask for removal at support@pipeworx.io and a removed name is replaced in the subject and its document link dropped (counted in withheld_by_removal_request). Each row has a subject_kind (person | organisation | mixed | unclassified) assigned only from explicit cues in the subject (honorific = person; corporate-form word = organisation); a bare personal name with neither cue is 'unclassified', not guessed, and subject_kind_basis says why. When nothing matches, returns found:false with the exact scope searched (a sanction announced in a press release but absent from the register is not covered).

query.description: Optional Spanish words to match in the resolution subject, e.g. "Itaú" or "Cooperativa Oriente". All words must match.

limit.description: Max rows to return (default 25, max 200). Newest first.

tools.name: cmf_regulation
tools.description: Look up CMF regulations: NCG (normas de carácter general), CIR (circulares) and OFC (oficios circulares). Pass a number (with type NCG|CIR|OFC) to resolve one norm, e.g. type=NCG number=514 returns its title, issue date, PDF link, the resolution that approved it, and which norms modify, repeal or are modified by it. Or pass a Spanish keyword query (e.g. "finanzas abiertas") and/or a year to list matching norms, newest first. At least one of number, query or year is required.

query.description: Spanish keyword(s) searched in the norm text/title, e.g. "finanzas abiertas".

tools.name: cmf_registry
tools.description: Look up a legal entity in the CMF registers by RUT or name. Returns (1) supervised-entity register hits: CMF code, name, entity type and whether the registration is current; and (2) the register of financial service providers created by Chile's Fintec law, with the services each provider is authorised for (crowdfunding platform, alternative trading system, credit advice, investment advice, custody, order routing, intermediation) and status. RUT may be written 77.532.023-0 or 77532023. An absent entity returns found:false with the scope searched, which means 'not in these registers', not 'does not exist'. Natural persons are never returned.

rut.description: Chilean RUT of the entity, e.g. "77.532.023-0".

name.description: Entity name or part of it, e.g. "Abaqus".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-cmf-chile forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the cmf-chile pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
